name: Tannan (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Tannan town emblem in white: a ring enclosing a stylised mountain, crossed by a winged bar.
history: Flag of the former town of Tannan in Hyōgo Prefecture, dissolved on 1999-04-01. The municipal emblem was adopted in 1965.

features.role: Tannan town emblem — a ring enclosing a stylised mountain, crossed by a winged bar
